scope: D10 availability sampling, examination weighting, fixed inputs, missing interval and conditional bootstrap uncertainty

own_study_claims.claim: The imaged subset comprises 182 of 238 eligible clinical examinations, 135 patients, 141 tumor and 41 treatment-change examinations; 56 examinations remain outside the paired comparison
Patients contribute 1 to 4 examinations; 99 contribute one, 27 two, 7 three and 2 four
Production fitting and pooled metrics weight examinations equally, without inverse-frequency patient weights; grouped folds have zero patient overlap
Fusion uses 13 fixed input coefficients plus an intercept, fixed L2 C=1, and no tuning or feature selection
Initial-event interval is missing for 36 examinations and combines initial surgery, other initial treatment or diagnosis; median imputation is within training fold, with a missingness indicator
Patient-cluster bootstrap resamples fixed OOF predictions, not development pipelines; 2000 saved valid draws, no model refits
Repeated grouped splits use the same underlying cohort and do not provide an independent external evaluation

interpretations: Availability selection may affect representativeness; no measured direction or magnitude of selection bias claimed
Repeat examinations do not increase the number of independent patients and examination weighting differs from equal patient weighting
A fixed penalized 13-input model does not by itself establish adequate estimation stability; no events-per-variable adequacy rule or retrospective power calculation applied
Median imputation and a missingness indicator do not recover unavailable timing history or establish an ignorable missingness mechanism; no claim that missingness is proven nonignorable
Fixed-OOF percentile intervals exclude full retraining and fold-partition uncertainty; repeated splits explore another conditional aspect, not external confirmation
citation_rationale: This paragraph interprets the project own saved design, sampling and uncertainty records; no external empirical or methodological guideline claim introduced
